title: Gender stereotypes in the mediated personalization of politics: Empirical evidence from a lexical, syntactic and sentiment analysis
reasoning: The paper investigates gender stereotypes in political news coverage using NLP techniques. While it includes 'moral and behavioral characteristics' as a category for analysis, this refers to personality traits and public perception stereotypes of politicians (e.g., active vs. passive) rather than the evaluation or benchmarking of religion, faith, theology, or formal ethics.
